Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: In a way, that makes it easier. Oui ?

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: I mean, if you do not feel « settled » anywhere, it is easier to uproot yourself and go to ... greener pastures, I think you say.

Line.Text: Le monde entier is yours to explore ! You do not have to look back all the time and wonder what could have been. Or wonder if it was right to leave home. Or ...
